items.summary: A release where you say "Finally!" ## Highlights 1. Customer and Supplier overview dashboards 2. Revamped Projects form with overview, task management, and costing 3. Dashboards powered by Insights 4. New report print formats 5. Day Book report 6. More than 2.5k bugs fixed in the last one month ## General Features (1) * Adds Insights workbooks for the Accounts, Payments, Asset, Buying, Selling, and Stock dashboards, which open in Insights when it is installed. Dashboard charts show amounts in each company’s currency and include empty weeks, months, and age ranges for companies with ledger activity. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/62237) Bug Fixes (15) * When creating a return from a **POS Invoice**, payment amounts exclude change already given, so the refund matches the original sale total. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/66207) * Restricts access to fiscal-year and other period date ranges to signed-in users; guests can no longer retrieve them. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/65882) * Adds _Cost Center_ and configured accounting dimensions to **Request for Quotation** items and carries them from **Material Request** items into **Supplier Quotation** items. Supplier quotations submitted through the portal use the dimensions saved on the **Request for Quotation**, rather than values entered by suppliers.
